{{Top|leg}}
A '''protocol chip''' was a component found in some [[Droid/Legends|droids]], giving them the cognitive functionality to engage socially with organic life forms. The [[TelBrinTel Corporation|TelBrinTel]] [[Science Research Droid]] had an advanced protocol chip, allowing it to participate in "creative brainstorming" sessions with living [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]].
